name: Valar Atomics
description: Valar Atomics is privately held and has no ticker. Review its funding rounds and valuations, the investors and SPVs that hold its shares, and the points to confirm before buying or selling.
ledes: Valar Atomics is a privately held nuclear energy company. Its shares are not listed on an exchange and have no quoted market price; the principal public reference points are the valuations at which the company has raised capital. Its most recent financing, a $1 billion Series B round announced on August 4, 2026, was reported to value the company at $6 billion.

Founded in 2023, Valar Atomics is developing small helium-cooled nuclear reactors and operates a test reactor, the Ward 250, in Utah. Existing shares change hands in privately negotiated transactions, frequently through special purpose vehicles, and remain subject to the company's transfer restrictions.
figs: Special purpose vehicles with SEC filings naming Valar Atomics
table_note: Valar Atomics has not disclosed its valuations; the Series B valuation is as reported at the time of the round. Amounts raised reflect equity only.
round_notes: Alongside the Series B, Valar Atomics arranged a $200 million credit facility led by Erebor Bank and J.P. Morgan. In March 2026, Bloomberg reported that the company had raised $450 million, comprising $340 million of equity and $110 million of debt, at a valuation of $2 billion.

A round valuation reflects the terms of the preferred stock issued in that round. Most shares sold by employees are common stock, which carries fewer rights and typically trades at a discount to the preferred price.
investors: Sequoia Capital led the Series B, joined by Point72, Atreides Management, Valor Equity Partners, Conviction and HOF Capital, as well as existing investors Riot Ventures, Snowpoint Ventures and Dream Ventures. Snowpoint Ventures led the Series A and Riot Ventures the seed round. Other investors include Day One Ventures, AlleyCorp, Initialized Capital, Palmer Luckey and Shyam Sankar.
spv_sentence: Since 2025, nine special purpose vehicles formed to invest in Valar Atomics have filed with the SEC, six of them in 2026.
sources: Sources: Valar Atomics' Series B announcement; reports by The Next Web (August 2026 and April 2026), Bloomberg (March 2026) and TechCrunch (February 2025); and SEC Form D filings.
